snippet.title: Clockwillows Voy Quest – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Live the adventure with Clockwillows Voy Quest!
Coming Soon, info on: epicalea.com
My first video game, made by Nicola Cerrato "Epicalea":

Take control of Voy and save your beloved Gioia from the clutches of the evil Dr. Del. This adventure is set in the Islands of Occhy, a magical place which coexists with science very different from ours, inhabited by many species and monsters of all kinds.

Coming Soon: Android & ChromeOS on Google Play – iOS, macOS (Apple Silicon, M Series chip) & tvOS on App Store – Windows 10/11 (64-bit) & SteamOS on Steam

Made with Unity.
